messages:
alex: heads-up — saw a regression on llm2-13b served with the chat template. 2.5–3.8% median p95 latency increase after yesterday's runtime build. suspect interaction between rope_theta defaults + SiLU path.

nina: ugh. can you paste the perf diffs? which kernel switched?

alex: TL;DR: autokernel switched from fused_qkv_matmul_v1 -> matmul+split path for a small portion of requests (head_dim=128, seq_len ~64). profiler shows extra memcpy + kernel launch overhead.

ryan: do we have a concrete repro? smallish trace would help.

alex: repro attached inline: ran perf_bench with same prompt distribution as customers. perf-bot posted the profile link: https://perf.internal/reports/2172501234/flamegraph

perf-bot: profiling summary: increased GPU kernel launches (+18%), extra allocs in kv-cache path, hotspot in "split_qkv_backward" (flamegraph link above). baseline vs current diff included.

maria: that matches my stacktrace when I hit throughput cliffs — kv cache eviction pattern triggers small-batch fallback which picks a different matmul kernel. we need to decide whether to force fused kernel for this config.

alex: curious part — rope_theta default changed slightly in the model metadata import (10.0 -> 9.2) on migration, which nudged the prefix handling and changed typical effective seq distribution feeding the kernel selector. weird chain: rope_theta -> chat-prefix length distribution -> batch slicing -> kernel selection.

nina: so it's an upstream metadata drift causing different execution path. can we add a quick mitigation: pin rope_theta in the model manifest or add a selector override?

ryan: short-term: add a model_manifest override to force kernel_hint: "prefer_fused_qkv" for llm2-13b. mid-term: improve selector heuristics to consider head_dim+kv_cache_hits before switching.

maria: also saw RMSNorm+SiLU combo changes magnifying the cost: SiLU path currently uses slower elementwise kernel not fused with rmsnorm for mixed-precision. when head_dim >= 128 it matters.

alex: config used for repro (run by perf team):
```json
{
  "model": "llama2-13b",
  "rope_theta": 9.2,
  "chat_template": "default_v2",
  "act_fn": "silu",
  "norm": "rmsnorm",
  "head_dim": 128,
  "batch_slice": "auto"
}
```

nina: thanks. action items?

ryan: 1) deploy a manifest pin for rope_theta=10.0 on the next canary (quick). 2) add kernel_hint metadata to model (prefer_fused_qkv) + unit test so selector won't flip. 3) follow-up task to fuse rmsnorm+silu path if possible. 4) add a regression alert for kernel launch count + memcpy %.

maria: I'll take the fs change for model manifest and the test. alex can you prepare the minimal reproducer script and the perf flamegraph excerpt to attach to the PR?

alex: on it. will post repro snippet and perf diff in the PR.

perf-bot: new build queued: canary with manifest pins will run perf suite in 30m and report back.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: cluster=dedicated-west-2, window=15m starting 2172501800.

nina: nice. after canary we should run long-tail chat load (1h) to verify p99 stable.

ryan: also we should log selector decisions in trace for a week so we can correlate customer latencies with kernel choices. lightweight flaggable logging only.

maria: created GH ticket: #infra/rt-llm2-kernel-selector (will link in PR).

alex: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll open the PR in ~15m with repro and perf excerpt.

maria: assigned follow-ups: manifest pin (maria), selector tests (maria + ryan), fuse investigation (ryan).

nina: closing loop — please paste canary perf results in thread when available.

perf-bot: canary perf completed: median latency back to baseline, kernel launch delta -16%, memcpy delta -21%. full report: https://perf.internal/reports/2172501234/canary
